exact_statement: For the actual Boolean sign g(x,y)=(-1)^(xy) on independent Bernoulli inputs with P(X=1)=p and fixed P(Y=1)=q in (0,1/2), and physical reveal A={X}, the Shannon spectral/physical-channel quantities satisfy J_A-M_A=4q(1-2q)*p*log2(1/p)+O_q(p) as p tends to zero. Consequently every scalar tau(p) such that J_A<=M_A+tau(p) for all finite actual Boolean signs under every interior product bias and every singleton block of bias p satisfies liminf_{p->0} tau(p)/(p*log2(1/p))>=1/2. In particular no universal O(p) tax is valid. This does not refute B09 Delta(p), prove its optimality, or disprove uniform-cube FEI.
hypotheses: actual two-bit AND sign, not an arbitrary normalized spectrum
independent interior product biases p and q
q fixed in (0,1/2) for the asymptotic; q=1/4 for the universal lower bound
orthonormal biased Fourier basis including the empty coefficient
physical reveal A={X} with actual branch probabilities
M_A=H(S_A|S_B), J_A=I(Z;S_B), all entropy in bits
refutes: universal scalar tax tau(p)=O(p) in biased singleton J_A<=M_A+tau(p)
